# BAD-013 — Ship audio separation to players with prebuilt demucs.cpp binaries or an in-app fetch

## Brief
From BadTakes TODO.md item 36 in Audio separation (added 2026-08-18). The creator's separation checkbox only appears when a demucs.cpp binary and its model resolve, and demucs.cpp has no installer or package, so the feature exists only for someone who compiles it and runs download-model demucs. Everyone else sees the setup hint forever, and creator-made scenes ship no background bed.

The model question (TODO item 38) is settled: on 2026-08-17 Eric compared six separators and picked htdemucs on cleanliness over fullness (it holds the original actor about 79 dB down; cinematic models leave audible speech residue). It shipped as src/createpack.js's DEMUCS_MODELS htdemucs-4s. Do not reopen the model choice in this ticket.

Fix direction: prebuild demucs_mt.cpp.main per platform on the bundled-ffmpeg pattern (build/fetch-ffmpeg.js: pinned checksum, staged dir, CI cache), or an in-app "Get separation tools" that downloads binary and model (about 81 MB from Hugging Face) into the creator home (~/.badtakes-creator/tools and models) the CLI already shares. Build notes: CMake 4 needs -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5; the mt binary takes a required fourth threads argument (demucsArgs handles per-binary argv); macOS links Accelerate via the default USE_OPENBLAS branch.

Licensing before shipping any of it: demucs.cpp is MIT but vendors Eigen (MPL2), and the htdemucs weights carry their own terms. Mirror the ffmpeg compliance-file treatment. The alternative is cloud separation as a paid job (see [[BAD-011]], cloud line-marking, and [[BAD-014]], the Choicer Voicer export that needs a bed); decide which before building both.
